title: Bounded exact controls for the timing-adaptive conversion candidate

renewal.scope: Finite IID controls support the general analytical epoch proof; they do not exhaust adaptive epoch laws.

adaptive_policies.scope: All timing-adaptive query policies in each finite game, with fresh independent copies only after exceptions.

backlog.scope: Necessity of log L order for the generic first-moment counter argument, not a lower bound for all indexes or compilers.

canonical_lookup.scope: Exact finite reduction controls, with no ANN index, timing benchmark, learned encoder or dynamic performance claim.

covering_memory.scope: Known covering-family algebra and dynamic exact-operator controls; bucket oracle is not a balanced-tree benchmark or an implementation of the timed wrapper.

all_prefix_restart.scope: Exact bounded checks of the classical exponential-supermartingale argument; finite games do not prove novelty or replace the all-prefix analytical proof.

covering_spectral.scope: Exact finite controls of the analytical spectral second-moment proof; no numerical eigenvalue approximation or novelty inference.

covering_fingerprints.scope: Finite fingerprints/FHT and complete-function controls, not a production balanced-tree index, benchmark, learned block or claim that compressed tables are independent.

constant_families.scope: Exact parameter arithmetic at an illustrative reset/base cost ratio 4*n, not measured costs or a proof of a practical speedup.

xor_covering.scope: Independent direct sums and exact joint-seed moments support the XOR/direct-bucket proof. Counts are RAM operation identities, not Python performance measurements or a novelty determination.

direct_buckets.scope: Bounded intrusive-list oracle checks deletion handles, raw-key edits, independent payloads and abort cleanup. Selected seeds are correctness controls, not a runtime-distribution experiment or production implementation.

sparse_shell.scope: Exact distributional and Jensen/Rayleigh controls; no sampled keys, numerical eigenvalues, training, performance benchmark or novelty inference. The written proof supplies the uniform theorem.

compact_timing_attack.scope: Exact rational packing/moment controls, exhaustive finite averaging games, a constant-weight geometry, conditional seed distributions and fresh-query cube algebra support the written proofs. Whole-RAM-time classification follows from the written expectation/Markov argument, not an empirical timing experiment. No full-index lower bound, neural model or novelty determination.

full_range_baseline.scope: Exact algebraic boundary checks support the written full-range arithmetic-model baseline derivation. No optimal LSF implementation, Gaussian experiment, finite-word compilation, adaptive-key theorem, measured performance or novelty claim.

sparse_signature_baseline.scope: Exact preallocated-trie oracle checks dynamic admission, atomic rejection, raw verification, scratch cleanup and independent weighted payloads against exhaustive Hamming reads. Integer controls support the written random-shell/asymptotic proof. This is a known signature-dictionary baseline consequence, not a new architecture, optimal implementation, performance benchmark or novelty claim.

product_spectral_baseline.scope: Exact Walsh/tensor algebra and a preallocated-array product decoder checked against direct raw Hamming reads, independent current payloads and full pure-basin perturbation controls. Large-radius boundary cases test correctness, not the subpolynomial regime. This is a classical product-indexing baseline consequence, not a new ML architecture, benchmark or novelty determination.

compound_rebuild_cost.scope: Exact finite controls for the written uniform compound-supermartingale proof. Finite timing games use bounded two-point rebuild marks, with trigger-dependent laws and fresh uniform seeds; actual unbounded geometric trial counts are checked by their closed infinite generating function. No novelty, architecture advantage or exhaustive infinite-adversary computation is claimed.

spectral_mixture_hardness.scope: Exact bounded certificates for an explicit near-identity-kernel encoding of Boolean rectangle means and a raw-bit repetition-basin decoder. All Boolean payload assignments are exhausted for side 2 and 3; larger cases use stated deterministic payload profiles. Every Boolean rectangle query is exhausted for each listed configuration. All raw bit perturbations up to the basin radius are exhausted only for side <=3 and spectral_slack_bits=1. The uniform spectral/retention/reduction proofs are analytical. The OMv conjecture, arbitrary raw-query performance, small-radius hardness, novelty and an architectural advantage are not verified or claimed.

subset_aggregate_candidate.scope: Exact tuple-map algorithm versus independent complete raw Hamming reads. Small dimensions exhaust all raw queries; larger cases exhaust stated one-hot queries for weight 5 and use systematic raw support/bit-flip controls. Dynamic admission is checked against all pair intersections, including proposals outside the initial codebook. Signed cancellations, atomic rejection, deletion/reuse, pure-noise reads, nontrivial independently overwritten/deleted mixtures, spectral row sums and exact parameter bounds are checked. The code is a bounded correctness control, not a finite-word arena implementation, runtime benchmark, learned encoder or novelty/strongest-baseline determination.

affine_coded_baseline.intersection_transform_scope: On three non-polynomial low-intersection families, exhaust all raw queries and three radii, checking the published full ranked up/down zeta moments and inverse Pascal distribution against direct intersection classes, then our low-order truncation plus exact unique-owner tail. This proves the algebraic equivalence, not that the published full-down-closure theorem already states the compressed dynamic bound or that the elementary compression is a novel contribution.
affine_coded_baseline.general_space_bound: For any 1<=h<k, cache C_h=sum_{j<=h}binom(p,j)*p^j cells and keep n=p^k independent value slots. State O_k,h((n+C_h)*(v+1)+p^2). The linear-space simplification additionally needs 2h<=k at fixed k. The h=k-1 controls also exercise the general, potentially superlinear fixed-k tradeoff.
affine_coded_baseline.uniform_bound: For fixed k,h with 1<=h<k and 2h<=k, odd prime p>=k, n=p^k, raw dimension p^2 and radius p: state O_k,h(n*(v+1)), exact reads O_k,h(p^2+p^(k-h-1)*(v+1)), overwrites/deletes O_k,h(p^h*(v+1)), raw admitted rekeys O_k,h(p^2+p^h*(v+1)). Field/precision bit costs are additional; guard bits and initialization are charged in the note. For k=5,h=2 scalar reads/rekeys are n^(2/5) up to word/precision factors, with linear state.
affine_coded_baseline.growing_dimension_scope: With k=floor(p/(4ceil(log2 p))) and h=k-1, keep exact C_h cells rather than the loose p^(2h) bound. This yields n^(1+o(1)) state/preprocessing, n^o(1) updates, and 2^O(k)*poly(p,k)*(v+1) complete raw reads. No implicit constant is treated as uniform in growing k; the note expands it. This is a codebook-specific comparator in the preceding generic candidate's asymptotic regime, not a novelty determination.
affine_coded_baseline.scope: Exact sparse-map correctness control, not a direct-array implementation, hardware benchmark or novelty proof. All raw-query numerators/denominators are checked against independent Hamming scans. Small complete codebooks and sparsely occupied larger fixed codebooks are distinguished; larger capacities are conceptual. The construction uses established soft interpolation and affine evaluation constraints with partial cached sums. It restricts key admission to a known polynomial codebook, so does not settle the priority or usefulness of the generic low-intersection candidate. No neural training or strongest-baseline separation is claimed.

exact_inverted_index_comparator.scope: Maintained coordinate postings plus total value sum give every full raw-query numerator/denominator independently of subset truncation. The verifier stores both comparison states and does not benchmark either. A standalone linked-posting implementation and its load-capped costs are accounted in the note; the prototype uses exact sets.

random_admission_controls.bound: At any current state with <=n keys, a fresh independent uniform weight-w proposal is rejected with probability <=min(1,n*binom(w,k)^2/binom(d,k)). This is conditional per proposal, not an event of no future rejection or a worst-case resampling bound.

weighted_exponential_candidate.finite_size_warning: Every shown key-subset count exceeds capacity, despite the eventual subpolynomial asymptotic bound. These examples certify inequalities and expose expensive finite constants; they do not certify useful ML latency.
weighted_exponential_candidate.scope: Exact tuple-map controls for full base-two exponential attention under a signed-integer raw-query l1 budget and certified low-intersection binary key admission. Independent direct dyadic dot-product sums check normalized output and scaled numerator/denominator, including negative coefficients/corrections, updates, generic admission, cancellation, deletion/reuse, malformed inputs, large precision and noisy grid retrieval. Python arbitrary integers are bounded against preselected guard bits; this is not a finite-word arena implementation or performance/novelty certificate. The 169-value retention example is fully installed. Other capacities are explicit. No learned encoder, training, strongest-baseline advantage or publication priority is established.

capacity_frontier_baselines.scope: Exact oracle checks for the classical length-stratified all-subsets kernel with a fixed length bias and separate raw-query support/amplitude budgets. Arbitrary distinct keys of weight <=w are admitted; no low-intersection rule or independent value-cache duplicate is used. Full cells isolate each current value. Standard packing/Johnson bounds, affine-geometry minimal-maximal families and exact rekey acceptance counts audit the older admission promise. These are known kernel/design mechanisms, not a novelty or ML-advantage certificate. Fixed-grid amplitude jitter is distinct from binary-key erasure correction. Large finite resource counts are arithmetic bounds, not allocated memory or measured runtime.

uniform_scalar_polynomial_obstruction.scope: Any single scalar polynomial uniformly approximating exp on the entire real score interval [-64,64] with relative error <=2^-16 has degree >=55. Its nonzero leading coefficient yields at least 1817936 potentially active top-degree monomials even after key-support pruning. This is a feature-recipe cost obstruction, not a general query lower bound, a finite-grid-only obstruction, or a bound against local/query-adaptive approximation, alternate representations, direct scanning or sketches.

continuous_amplitude_baseline.scope: Classical sparse monomial/Taylor feature attention with dyadic raw amplitudes, exact canonical current-value deltas, all independent values separately stored, explicit word guards and a uniform relative-exp remainder bound. Independent scalar-dot polynomial sums certify every full numerator/denominator, and rational exp-weight enclosures certify a small retention example. Seven conceptual packing/gap controls support the asymptotic nontrivial-noise family but do not allocate those states or certify a learned encoder. The feature mechanisms are prior art; no strongest-method, novelty, ML latency or publication certificate is claimed.
